description: Core math + training path: diffeo.exp_compose_upsampled (per-image tf.map_fn), cascade.integrate_frozen_at, an immutable integration_grid attribute ('native' default | 'current') on FrozenStage / FrozenChain with current-mode deform / deform_stages / deform_skip / svf(s), the --frozen-integration-grid flag with the chain rule (pure resolver in runtime/args.py), main.py + runtime/eval_run.py wiring and config.json recording. runtime/run.py is NOT changed (all trainer, validation and BN-recal paths go through the cascade methods). Plan decisions D1-D4, D6 and items 1-3 in plan.md. First feature; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on its names.
steps: Read plan.md (decisions D1-D6, items 1-3, Digest) in d:\Research\Brain_Registration_Projects\brain-group-rad\.worktrees\fine-grid-integration\.agents\tasks\fine-grid-integration\plan.md.

models/diffeo.py: add exp_compose_upsampled(vs, ups, steps=7, lean=False, return_first=False) after compose_cascade. vs = list of float32 [N, X_k, Y_k, Z_k, 3] SVFs (coarse first), ups = list of non-negative ints (upsample_displacement count per SVF); all upsampled static spatial shapes must be equal (ValueError otherwise; len(vs) == len(ups) >= 1). Body per image via tf.map_fn(fn, tuple(vs), fn_output_signature=(TensorSpec(shape [X,Y,Z,3], float32), ...), parallel_iterations=1): v = v_i[None]; upsample ups[k] times; u, ui = exp_and_inverse(v, steps, lean); first: acc, acc_inv = u, ui (keep as first if return_first); else acc = compose(acc, u), acc_inv = compose(ui, acc_inv). Return (u, u_inv) or (u, u_inv, u0, u0_inv). Add a docstring-table row 'Fine-grid frozen integration' to the module docstring.

models/cascade.py: INTEGRATION_GRIDS = ('native', 'current'); _check_grid(value) -> ValueError for anything else; integrate_frozen_at(svfs, level, steps, return_first=False) where svfs = list of (level_k, v_k) coarse first, ups_k = {4:2,2:1,1:0}-style log2(level_k/level) (ValueError if level_k < level), calling diffeo.exp_compose_upsampled.

FrozenStage: __init__(model, integration_grid='native') stores the validated value; every factory (from_checkpoint, from_model, from_config) takes integration_grid='native' and passes it on. New svf(images_fine) -> tf.stop_gradient(model(pool(x), task=DEFORM_TASK, training=False)['v']). deform(): native branch = today's code verbatim; current branch: out = model(...); v = out['v']; U, U_inv = integrate_frozen_at([(4, v)], 2, model.config.integration_steps); return stop_gradient of U, U_inv and V = upsample_displacement(v).

FrozenChain: __init__(stage4, model2, integration_grid=None): None -> stage4.integration_grid; an explicit value different from stage4's -> ValueError; factories from_checkpoint(prefix, cfg, expected_fingerprint4, integration_grid='native'), from_config(cfg, integration_grid='native'), from_models(model4, model2, integration_grid='native') build FrozenStage with the same value. New svfs(images_l1, skip4=None) -> dict {4: v4', 2: v2}: x2 = pool(x1); v4 = stage4.svf(x2); v4' = skip_fields(skip4, [v4])[0] if skip4 is not None; prewarp field = integrate_frozen_at([(4, v4')], 2, T)[0] in current mode, stage4.deform(x2)['U'] in native mode (then for skip4 in native mode use skip_fields on it, matching deform_skip); v2 = model2(prewarp_deform(x2, U4_2), task=DEFORM_TASK, training=False)['v']; all stop_gradient. Current-mode branches (native branches verbatim): deform -> U, U_inv = integrate_frozen_at([(4, v4), (2, v2)], 1, T), V = up(v2); deform_stages -> one integrate_frozen_at(..., return_first=True) call gives U, U_inv, U4, U4_inv; V = up(v2), V4 = up(up(v4)); deform_skip(images_l1, skip4, skip2) -> v4' via svfs(skip4), v2' = skip_fields(skip2, [v2])[0] if skip2 is not None, U, U_inv = integrate_frozen_at([(4, v4'), (2, v2')], 1, T). Add an 'Integration grid' row to the module docstring table. linear paths unchanged.

runtime/args.py: in the 'level cascade' group add --frozen-integration-grid choices native|current default None with help text stating the chain rule. In the checks after line ~733: 'current' without --cascade-from -> parser.error('--frozen-integration-grid current needs --cascade-from'). Add TF-free resolve_frozen_integration_grid(requested, source_level=None, source_cascade=None, saved_cascade=None) implementing plan D4 (fresh L2: requested or 'native'; fresh L1: source value = (source_cascade or {}).get('frozen_integration_grid', 'native'), None inherits, mismatch -> ValueError; resume (saved_cascade not None): saved value, None inherits, mismatch -> ValueError). Messages name both values and the source path is added by main.py.

main.py: after the fresh/resume decision resolve the grid: resume -> resolve(..., saved_cascade=saved_cfg['cascade']) (ValueError -> RuntimeError); fresh L1 -> source_cascade = cascade_src[2]['upstream_cascade'] (ValueError -> SystemExit 'main.py: --cascade-from <path>: ...'); fresh L2 -> source_level 4. On cascade runs set args.frozen_integration_grid = resolved before write_config / log_params; non-cascade runs leave the parsed value (None, or 'native' if given) untouched. Pass integration_grid=resolved to every FrozenStage/FrozenChain factory call (resume from_config, fresh from_checkpoint). Put cascade_rec['frozen_integration_grid'] = resolved into both fresh records and make sure the resume record (from _refresh_skip_record) holds the resolved value. Add the grid to _cascade_lines and a paragraph to the module docstring (flag + rule).
runtime/eval_run.py: pass integration_grid=(cascade or {}).get('frozen_integration_grid', 'native') to FrozenChain/FrozenStage.from_config.

TestFrozenCurrent (reuse tests.test_cascade CascadeCase/ChainCase helpers: FrozenStage.from_model(m4, integration_grid='current') at level 2 equals the manual reference; native deform output bitwise equal to up(model(pool(x))['u']) etc.; native traced graph of deform has no 'While'/'StatelessWhile' op and current has one; level-1 chain current: deform, deform_stages and deform_skip(skip4 / skip2 / both, tf.constant(True)) equal manual references (pool, v4, exp at L2 for the model2 pre-warp, v2, integrate both at L1 with compose); V / V4 equal the native ones; GradientTape over x gives None gradients for U and U_inv; bad grid value -> ValueError; FrozenChain with mismatching stage4 grid -> ValueError). TestChainRule (pure resolver cases of plan D4 + parse_args error for current without --cascade-from + default None). TestMainCascadeGrid (follow TestCascadeResume ~1370-1460 in tests/test_cascade.py: overfit-mode L4 source run, then L2 with --frozen-integration-grid current -> config.json args.frozen_integration_grid == 'current' and cascade.frozen_integration_grid == 'current'; resume without the flag keeps current; resume with native -> RuntimeError; a default L2 run records 'native'). TestTrainerCurrent (CascadeTrainerCase-style level-2 Trainer with a current FrozenStage: one deform train step finite, frozen weights fingerprint unchanged, the eval-mode validation frozen fields equal frozen.deform outputs, Trainer._prewarp deform input == prewarp_deform(x, frozen.deform(x)['U'])).
